power.method: 24 VAC, High PoE 60 W (NPD-6001B, required for heater) or PoE+ 30 W (IEEE 802.3at Class 4, without heater); redundant

storage.notes: Full-size SD card slot, max 2 TB (microSD not recommended)

features: Open camera platform (Security & Safety Things application store)
Starlight: 0.0077 lx color / 0.0008 lx mono (30 IRE, F1.6)
Intelligent Video Analytics; three independent streams; H.265
Pan 360 deg continuous; preset speed pan 400 deg/s, tilt 300 deg/s
Outdoor pendant, cast aluminum, IK10 nylon bubble, NEMA 4X
7 alarm inputs (2 supervised), 4 alarm outputs; audio line in/out

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.

release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (NDP_7602_Z30K_Data_sheet_enUS_84741847051.pdf). -K = IK10 rugged bubble outdoor pendant. Power 51 W / 54 VA typical with heaters (19.2 W heaters off). Operating -40 to +55 C with heater wired (-10 to +55 C without). Max frame rate is not stated explicitly (IP delay quoted at 30 fps), so max_fps is left out. Autotracking is not listed, so ptz is left out.
